correctness.rationale: The exact PROP1 event is equivalent to two integer deficits at most two. Their sum is nonpositive, so the violations are disjoint. Five direct outcome types yield the two trinomial coefficient tails; exponential tilting and aperiodic local CLT give the interior prefactors. A common signed shared-good walk and exclusive-good LLN give the Gaussian threshold, and binomial counting gives the fully approving boundary. An exact-rational independent outcome enumerator passed 106 finite checks. No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The fully specified binary Like arrival model is a central natural example for online fair allocation. The theorem separates exponentially likely realized PROP1 at interior approval rates from a one-half/zero boundary dichotomy and quantitatively resolves its square-root crossover, supplying exact finite-horizon risk evaluation and a mathematically motivated phase diagram.
